   **Bugs and stability.**
      16 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 14, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _alikat2304_, Aug 3, 2026, 2/5: "Sadly the app is full of pop ups that are hard to close, it is always freezing, and you can never find the option to report an issue with the bike! In general a poor app experience"
            2. _Samuel5757_, Aug 5, 2026, 4/5: "I’ve had a frustrating few weeks with Forest. I bought several minute bundles that I either couldn’t use properly because the app wouldn’t let me start or end rides during the recent technical issues, and it took much longer than I’d have liked to get everything resolved. That said, I do want to give credit where it’s due. I eventually managed to get through on the live chat, and the issue was resolved. It’s a shame I had to go the extra mile to get there, as it did leave me feeling ignored for a while, but the support I received in the end was genuinely helpful. The recent technical issues have clearly been significant, and I appreciate that it’s not easy for a smaller, home-grown business to deal with problems on that scale. Communication could certainly be improved during outages, but I’m hopeful this has been a learning experience. For now, my faith in Forest has been restored. I really like the service when it’s working well, and I’m looking forward to seeing the reliability and customer support continue to improve. Keep it up!"
